justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, enum JobState, and typed QueueError are used; minor weakness is the optional retry_at field rather than encoding state-specific data inside the JobState/Job representation.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with two distinguishing variants and Display impl; uses an undocumented expect("present") and an assert! in the constructor instead of returning a Result.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public items are documented with sensible derives and a narrow surface, but JobState lacks Clone/Copy and QueueError doesn't implement std::error::Error, which is conventional.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, ok_or, and derives, but the get_state match-rewriting JobState variant-by-variant (instead of deriving Clone/Copy) and the dead-code retry_at.map(|_| ...) chain in fail are non-idiomatic.
